summary: Verified the swap to real media/links on the YUNG DSA single-page site. All 13 review-request bullet points pass: hero uses img.youtube.com (MAAF KAR still) with no unsplash anywhere; latest release FACHADI/2026 has correct YouTube thumbnail, watch link and platform hrefs; latest-release-play-button opens video-modal with the exact youtube-nocookie embed src (?autoplay=1&rel=0); backdrop click closes modal while clicking inside does not; discography filter counts ALL=10 / SINGLE=9 / FEATURED=1 (HUSTLE IS A FLEX); release-play-2 opens MAAF KAR embed (plK0mRQEluI); Spotify iframe has correct artist embed src; 3 video cards shown; video-card-1 opens ZMQBrlntZEM; VIEW ALL VIDEOS link correct; About portrait is from image-cdn-ak.spotifycdn.com and bio mentions Pune 06 / Gully Gang Records / Sony Music India; gallery has 4 items and gallery-image-0 uses the rollingstoneindia.com image with lightbox showing matching caption; press-feature-rolling-stone has the right href and headline; press-kit-placeholder.pdf returns HTTP 200 application/pdf (542 bytes); 4 social links present with correct hrefs and target=_blank (no Amazon); booking submit shows success and backend POST returns 200/received=true; POST with missing required fields returns 422; mobile 390x844 has no horizontal overflow, mobile menu opens and closes after tapping nav-videos-link.

issues: Third-party iframes render 'Application error' / 'Video unavailable' inside headless Chromium only — expected environment artifact per request. Iframe src attributes are correct, so this is not a real app bug.

critical_code_review_comments: App.js is a single very long JSX line per section — functionally fine but hard to maintain; consider splitting the site into section components (Hero, LatestRelease, Discography, etc.) for readability.
Submit handler catches any error as a toast but does not surface server-side validation errors to the user (acceptable for an MVP contact form).
server.py has no explicit validation for email format on BookingInquiry (uses plain str). Low priority.
seed_data_creation: Two TEST_ prefixed booking inquiries inserted into MongoDB booking_inquiries collection via pytest and UI flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_booking_api.py (pytest). All data-testid selectors used in the review request exist and work. Known-expected console noise: React minified error #418 and a 'client-side exception' message that originate from the embedded Spotify iframe (next.js inside the embed) — these are third-party and should be ignored per the review request.
rca of the issue: No bugs found — all media/link swaps are implemented correctly.
